items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: Well, Suga was over there. Jack Pyee.

ctx.x: Peter Bocas could give you all those colors. We did interview him. He talked for quite a while. Then he told him. I forgot the name for him.
Well, Suga was over there. Jack Pyee. And Buddy Johnson. And Mr. That other fella. Did you tell anything about George McCullum? Yeah. I don't mean the boy. I'm talking about the daddy.
I have a good picture of him too. Yeah, the old man and the boy.
